arxiv-2104-07747.creator: Zachary Dell

We construct an equivalence between the 2-categories 𝓥 ​ MonCat G 𝒜 \boldsymbol{\mathcal{V}}\textbf{MonCat}_{G}^{\mathcal{A}} of rigid 𝒱 \mathcal{V} -monoidal categories for a braided monoidal category 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and 𝓥 ​ ModTens G 𝒜 \boldsymbol{\mathcal{V}}\textbf{ModTens}_{G}^{\mathcal{A}} of oplax braided functors from 𝒱 \mathcal{V} into the Drinfeld centers of ordinary rigid monoidal categories.

arxiv-2105-07225.title: Holographic phonons by gauge-axion coupling
arxiv-2105-07225.creator: Xi-Jing Wang 1, Wei-Jia Li 2
arxiv-2105-07225.description: Abstract In this paper, we show that a simple generalization of the holographic axion model can realize spontaneous breaking of translational symmetry by considering a special gauge-axion higher derivative term. The finite real part and imaginary part of the stress tensor imply that the dual boundary system is a viscoelastic solid.

arxiv-2112-06644.title: Nonconservative unimodular gravity: a viable cosmological scenario
arxiv-2112-06644.creator: Júlio C. Fabris, Marcelo H. Alvarenga, Mahamadou Hamani-Daouda, Hermano Velten
arxiv-2112-06644.description: Abstract In this work we review the issue of imposing the conservation of the energy-momentum tensor as a necessary condition to recover the equivalence between the unimodular gravity and General Relativity (GR) equipped with a cosmological constant. This procedure is usually interpreted as an ad hoc imposition on the unimodular theory’s structure.

arxiv-2202-00776.title: On Products of Random Matrices
arxiv-2202-00776.creator: Natalia Amburg, Aleksander Orlov, Dmitry Vasiliev
arxiv-2202-00776.description: Abstract We introduce a family of models, which we name matrix models associated with children’s drawings—the so-called dessin d’enfant. Dessins d’enfant are graphs of a special kind drawn on a closed connected orientable surface (in the sky). The vertices of such a graph are small disks that we call stars.

arxiv-2206-05133.title: On the square-root approximation finite volume scheme for nonlinear drift-diffusion equations
arxiv-2206-05133.creator: Clément Cancès, Juliette Venel
arxiv-2206-05133.description: Abstract . We study a finite volume scheme for the approximation of the solution to convection diffusion equations with nonlinear convection and Robin boundary conditions. The scheme builds on the interpretation of such a continuous equation as the hydrodynamic limit of some simple exclusion jump process.

arxiv-2406-15444.title: Cutting Through the Noise: Boosting LLM Performance on Math Word Problems
arxiv-2406-15444.creator: Ujjwala Anantheswaran, Himanshu Gupta, Kevin Scaria, Shreyas Verma, Chitta Baral, Swaroop Mishra
arxiv-2406-15444.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at various tasks, including solving math word problems (MWPs), but struggle with real-world problems containing irrelevant information. To address this, we propose a prompting framework that generates adversarial variants of MWPs by adding irrelevant variables. We introduce a dataset, ProbleMathic containing both adversarial and non-adversarial MWPs.

arxiv-2501-19060.title: Shift-Aware Calibration for Fine-Tuned CLIP: Leveraging Image-Text Alignment
arxiv-2501-19060.creator: Song-Lin Lv, Yu-Yang Chen, Zhi Zhou, Lan-Zhe Guo \corresponding
arxiv-2501-19060.description: Abstract Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, adapt effectively to downstream tasks through prompt tuning, but fine-tuning can misalign predictive confidence and accuracy, particularly on unseen classes. Existing VLM-specific calibration methods mainly rely on textual features of train classes, limiting their applicability across class and distribution shifts.

arxiv-2507-09805.title: Federated Learning with Graph-Based Aggregation for Traffic Forecasting CCS: Computing methodologies Neural networks
arxiv-2507-09805.creator: Audri Banik, Glaucio Haroldo Silva de Carvalho, Renata Dividino
arxiv-2507-09805.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Audri Banik, Glaucio Haroldo Silva de Carvalho, Renata Dividino. In traffic prediction, the goal is to estimate traffic speed or flow in specific regions or road segments using historical data collected by devices deployed in each area. Each region or road segment can be viewed as an individual client that measures local traffic flow, making Federated Learning (FL) a suitable approach for collaboratively training models without sharing raw data.

arxiv-2507-16957.title: Bye binormal: analysing the joint PDF of galaxy density and weak lensing convergence
arxiv-2507-16957.creator: Oliver Friedrich, Lina Castiblanco, Anik Halder, Cora Uhlemann
arxiv-2507-16957.description: Abstract At any given scale, 3 × \times 2-point statistics extract only three numbers from the joint distribution of the cosmic matter density and galaxy density fluctuations: their variances and their covariance. It is well known that the full shape of the PDF of those fluctuations contains significantly more information than can be accessed through these three numbers.

arxiv-2508-14835.creator: Alessandro Bondi, Martin Forde
arxiv-2508-14835.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alessandro Bondi, Martin Forde. We show weak convergence of the marginals for a re-scaled rough Heston model to a Normal Inverse Gaussian (NIG) Lévy process. britannica-1911-memmingen.title: Memmingen (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-memmingen.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-memmingen.description: Article 'Memmingen' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. It is partly surrounded with walls, and has some interesting old gates and houses. It contains the fine Gothic church of St Martin, which contains 67 beautifully carved choir-stalls, and a town hall dating from about 1580. Its industrial products are yarn, calico, woollen goods, thread. A considerable trade is carried on in hops, which are extensively cultivated in the neighbourhood, and in cattle, wool, leather and grain.

pmc-10553021.title: Long-term outcomes of highly experienced people with HIV undergoing salvage therapy with raltegravir
pmc-10553021.creator: Jesús Enrique Patiño Escarcina, Eduardo Martins Netto, Carlos Brites
pmc-10553021.description: Raltegravir and other third-line drugs have shown promise in improving outcomes in treatment-experienced patients. However, the efficacy and tolerability of these agents vary. This study assessed real-life virologic success, long-term survival, and adverse events in patients receiving raltegravir or other third-line drugs as salvage regimens.

pmc-11323397.title: In vivo fluorescence imaging of nanocarriers in near-infrared window II based on aggregation-caused quenching
pmc-11323397.creator: Zichen Zhang, Chang Liu, Yi Lu, Weili Zhao, Quangang Zhu, Haisheng He, Zhongjian Chen, Wei Wu
pmc-11323397.description: Accurate fluorescence imaging of nanocarriers in vivo remains a challenge owing to interference derived mainly from biological tissues and free probes. To address both issues, the current study explored fluorophores in the near-infrared (NIR)-II window with aggregation-caused quenching (ACQ) properties to improve imaging accuracy.

pmc-11617115.title: Pyrvinium Pamoate Alone and With Gemcitabine Exhibits Anti‐Pancreatic Cancer Activity in 2D and 3D Cell Culture Models
pmc-11617115.creator: Karabo Serala, Jinming Bai, Sharon Prince
pmc-11617115.description: Pancreatic cancer is an intractable disease with the worst prognosis of all common cancers. The treatment regimens currently used for pancreatic cancer do not significantly impact patient survival, and therefore, effective treatment strategies are urgently needed. Drug repurposing, which identifies new indications for existing and approved drugs, has proven to be a desirable approach to anti‐cancer drug discovery.

pmc-11620078.title: Investigating the mechanical properties and crashworthiness of hybrid PLA/GFRP composites fabricated using FDM-filament winding
pmc-11620078.creator: Ariyana Dwiputra Nugraha, Rahmad Kuncoro Adi, Vishnu Vijay Kumar, Arif Kusumawanto, Budi Prawara, Endro Junianto, Muhammad Fathul Hikmawan, Muhammad Akhsin Muflikhun
pmc-11620078.description: The failure and crashworthiness performance of hybrid Polylactide (PLA)/Glass Fiber Reinforced Polymer (GFRP) composite tubes subjected to axial and radial quasistatic compression loads were investigated in the present study. The composite tubes are fabricated using hand lay-up and Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM)-filament winding processes.

pmc-11652938.creator: Nivin A Nasser, Marwan Osman, Jouman Hassan, Tongzhu Xu, David Mann, Xiangyu Deng, Issmat I Kassem
pmc-11652938.description: maechei is often implicated in nosocomial infections [1]. This is primarily due to its adaptability to antimicrobial treatments and its opportunistic pathogenesis [1]. E. hormaechei has been frequently associated with multidrug resistance (MDR), exhibiting reduced susceptibility to critically important antibiotics.

pmc-11712335.title: Alzheimer’s and Related disorders Multicenter Archive (ARMA): a collaborative platform to advance ADRD diagnosis and treatment in Spain
pmc-11712335.creator: Ignacio Illán‐Gala
pmc-11712335.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAlzheimer’s and related disorders (ADRD) represent a range of neurodegenerative conditions characterized by abnormal protein deposits in the brain. Despite advances, there is a need for enhanced diagnostic and treatment approaches that acknowledge the diversity of ADRD.

pmc-12357458.title: Exploring the relationship between obstetric violence, postpartum depression, and breastfeeding through structural equation modelling: evidence from 2015 Pelotas birth cohort
pmc-12357458.creator: Marilia Arndt Mesenburg, Emanuele Souza Marques, Tatiana Henriques Leite, Maria do Carmo Leal, Mariangela Freitas Silveira
pmc-12357458.description: BackgroundObstetric violence is a gender-based violence against women perpetrated by health professionals during pregnancy and childbirth and presents negative consequences for women and newborns. Our objective was to evaluate the effect of obstetric violence on breastfeeding and the role of postpartum depression as a mediator.

pmc-12608534.title: Placenta-Derived Secretions Promote Liver Dysfunction, and Hepatic Serum Amyloid A Mediates Kidney Inflammatory Response in a Preeclampsia-like Mouse Model
pmc-12608534.creator: Ren Ozawa, Sae Suzuki, Ayaka Shirota, Shota Nomura, Takanori Komada, Masafumi Takahashi, Hisataka Iwata, Koumei Shirasuna
pmc-12608534.description: Preeclampsia (PE) is characterized by maternal hypertension accompanied with multi-organ dysfunction, such as maternal hepatic and renal dysfunction. Abnormal placental conditions may play a key role in regulating maternal organ function by promoting systemic inflammation. This study aimed to test the hypothesis that placenta-derived secretions contribute to hepatic and renal injury through interorgan communication using a PE-like mouse model.

pmc-12756628.title: Protocol to isolate quiescent hepatic stellate cells in sufficient yield while maintaining cytokine responsiveness from aged female mice
pmc-12756628.creator: Takao Seki, Sachiko Komazawa-Sakon, Yuichi Tsuchiya, Kyoko Fukuhara, Yasuhiro Nakano, Kenichi Ikejima, Katsuhide Okunishi, Hiroyasu Nakano
pmc-12756628.description: SummaryIsolation of primary hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) in sufficient quantities is technically challenging. We present a protocol for isolating quiescent HSCs from mice using Nycodenz density-gradient centrifugation. The procedure includes cervical dislocation, vena cava cannulation, liver perfusion, enzymatic digestion, and preparation for density separation. We then describe centrifugation, enrichment, washing, counting, and culture preparation.

pmc-12980979.title: Quality of life among people with tuberculosis in the Eastern Cape, South Africa: a qualitative study
pmc-12980979.creator: Nancy Bedingfield, Kuhle Fiphaza, Mahilet Girma, Liyabuya Majiza, Lindsey De Vos, Dawie Olivier, Aaron M. Kipp, Andrew Medina-Marino, Amrita Daftary
pmc-12980979.description: BackgroundQuality of life (QoL) for people affected by tuberculosis (TB) is generally poor. However, little is known about when and why it changes during treatment. Such knowledge is key to the development and implementation of meaningful interventions. We sought to explore perceptions of QoL amongst people with pulmonary TB during and after treatment.

pmc-13357187.title: A mechanovascular framework for pre-neoplastic microenvironmental dysregulation and early carcinogenesis
pmc-13357187.creator: Amal Bhanu Vayakkattil, Aiswarya Sivan Pazhanchery, Varsha Vijayarajan, Udayabhanu Vayakkattil
pmc-13357187.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Aerobic glycolysis is a defining feature of many solid tumors; however, the upstream physiological conditions that initiate and stabilize this metabolic phenotype during early carcinogenesis remain incompletely understood. Here, we propose a mechanovascular framework in which chronic vasomotor dysregulation, endothelial glycocalyx disruption, low-grade inflammation, endothelial hyperpermeability, and impaired lymphatic drainage collectively contribute to elevated interstitial fluid pressure and progressive extracellular matrix remodeling prior to clinically detectable tumor formation.

pmc-13535390.title: 79 Renal Cell Carcinoma Among Native American Patients in Oklahoma: A Single-Institution Experience from an NCI-Designated Cancer Center
pmc-13535390.creator: Jafer Raza, Anoushka Mullasseril, Abhirami Das, Kai Ding, Maribeth Mead, Saqib Balkhi, Dorothy Rhoades, Mark Doescher, Kelly Stratton, Brian Cross, Andrew McIntosh, Sanjay Patel, Michael Cookson, Adanma Ayanambakkam
pmc-13535390.description: BackgroundNative American (NA) populations in Oklahoma experience disproportionately high incidence (43.7 vs 20.7 per 100,000) and mortality (8.6 vs 4.7 per 100,000) from renal cell carcinoma (RCC) compared with Non-Hispanic White (NHW) populations. However, population-based datasets lack patient-level clinical detail, limiting understanding of outcomes both overall and at academic cancer centers.
